title: Document and witness the restart-rebuilt closing-checkpoint retry closing the prior grant bare
outcome: rebuild_engram_admission_retry_on_load also runs engram_admission_retry_head_matches, so an acknowledged retry under the closing-checkpoint exception survives a restart. After a restart there is no cached report, and the recovery checkpoint closes the prior grant bare (engram_host_adapter.rs:7199-7203). docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md says it carries 'the report the lost close built'. The docs state the restart case, and a witness covers it.
acceptance: The docs paragraph on the closing-checkpoint exception states that after a restart the rebuilt retry closes the prior grant bare, and a witness rebuilds the acknowledged retry from the saved record and shows the bare close before the head's evaluate and a single delivery.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
